name: speckit-specify
conclusion_quantitative: speckit-specify (Ask) specifies 4 of 5 categories: 3 autonomy limits, 5 clarification rules, 1 validation rule, 1 escalation rule; none for approval gates. Strongest: clarification rules.
conclusion_qualitative: speckit-specify creates or updates a feature specification from a natural-language description. The agent fills gaps with reasonable defaults and asks at most 3 critical clarifying questions, presented together. A quality checklist validates the spec, and the user is warned when issues remain after 3 rounds of fixes. It sets no approval gates.

autonomy_limits.conclusion_quantitative: 3 autonomy limits (3 mandatory, 0 advisory; 2 conditional), mostly prose.
autonomy_limits.conclusion_qualitative: There are 3 rules, all strict, 2 tied to a situation, mostly running text. The agent does not ask the user to repeat the feature description unless it was empty, makes informed guesses beyond the 3 most critical open questions, and does not ask about details that have reasonable defaults.

statements.quote: Do not ask the user to repeat it unless they provided an empty command.
**LIMIT CHECK**: If more than 3 markers exist, keep only the 3 most critical (by scope/security/UX impact) and make informed guesses for the rest

clarification_rules.conclusion_quantitative: 5 clarification rules (5 mandatory, 0 advisory; 2 conditional), mostly list.
clarification_rules.conclusion_qualitative: There are 5 rules, all strict, 2 tied to a situation, all bullet points. The agent marks a point as needing clarification only for critical decisions without a reasonable default, at most 3 of them, presents all its questions together and waits for the user's answers.

statements.quote: Only mark with [NEEDS CLARIFICATION: specific question] if:
Present all questions together before waiting for responses
Wait for user to respond with their choices for all questions (e.g., "Q1: A, Q2: Custom - [details], Q3: B")

approval_gates.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never tells the agent to get the user's permission or confirmation before doing something.

validation.conclusion_quantitative: 1 validation rule (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly list.
validation.conclusion_qualitative: There is one strict rule, tied to a situation, in a bullet point. The agent checks each item of the spec-quality checklist to see whether it passes or fails.

statements.quote: For each item, determine if it passes or fails

escalation.conclusion_quantitative: 1 escalation rule (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly list.
escalation.conclusion_qualitative: There is one strict rule, tied to a situation, in a bullet point. If the spec still fails the checklist after 3 iterations, the agent records the remaining issues and warns the user.

statements.quote: If still failing after 3 iterations, document remaining issues in checklist notes and warn user
